description: An improved ConsoleFilter mod that filters log messages not only by text, but also by log level (info, error, etc.). Gain better control over your console output to reduce noise and focus on what's important — ideal for debugging and error tracking.

mods.name: Console Filter Next
mods.description: Filter Minecraft console logs by text, regex, level, thread, source, and mod id. Client and dedicated server. Originally based on ConsoleFilter by Matthew Czyr. Maintained by alanjmrt94.
